description.p: Mudlet is a quality MUD (Multi-User Dungeon) client, designed to take mudding to a new level. It's a modern breed of a client on the gaming scene – with an intuitive user interface, a specially designed scripting framework, and a very fast text display.

ul.li: Simple to use with an intuitive user interface
Very fast text display handling thousands of lines in under a second
Rich Lua-based scripting framework with extensive API
Excellent script editor with syntax highlighting
Powerful and simple to use GMCP (Generic MUD Communication Protocol)
Cross-platform: runs on Windows, macOS and Linux
Full compatibility: run same scripts on any platform

description.p: Whether you're a power user creating complex automation or a casual gamer exploring text-based worlds, Mudlet provides a modern, feature-rich environment for playing MUDs.
